# `cpu` check

Sample CPU usage on this machine.

```yaml
checks:
  example:
    type: cpu
    expect:
      usage: { warn: 80%, fail: 95% }
```

## Keys

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sample` | duration | `1s` | How long to measure CPU usage. |
| `expect` | mapping |  | What counts as healthy. |
| `expect.usage` | {warn, fail} percent | `{warn: 80%, fail: 95%}` | Average usage across all CPUs. Triggers when the value is above the threshold. |

Every check also accepts the [common keys](../config.md#common-check-keys).

One-liner: `medic check cpu [--set key=value ...]`
